text: Honestly, I’m here to learn being new in this bank and I expect a lot from you.
I can follow instructions, but when it's just 'do this, do that', it doesn't really build my confidence. I'm still learning.
I made a mistake because I wasn't fully trained on that system yet. I just wish I had more support instead of just being told I messed up.
Thank you, that means a lot. When you give me clear direction and support, I feel much more confident in my data entry.
I think I could try verifying the data batches twice before submission. I appreciate you asking for my ideas.
I mean that I'm sometimes hesitant to ask for help when I get stuck on a new transaction type, and I want to know I can come to you.
I've been on the customer service desk for a bit now, and I have some ideas on how we can improve the queue flow.
If you don't want to hear my ideas, why should I even try to improve things around here? My previous boss made a lot of promises that were never met.
I'd love to take on that extra responsibility. Having more autonomy and seeing that my ideas matter really motivates me.
I've handled my teller station perfectly today, but I have to say, the workload distribution isn't fair. I am underpaid for what I do.
I know how to do my job, you don't need to micromanage me. The issue is the salary and how others aren't pulling their weight. You are not a fair boss.
Thank you for actually listening to how I feel. I just want to feel valued for the hard work I put in.
The accounts are balanced. I don't need much supervision, but honestly, I've been a bit stressed lately with some personal health concerns.
If you are just going to brush past my concerns, we have nothing to discuss. I handle my own work anyway.
I appreciate the reassurance. Knowing I have a supervisor I can trust gives me peace of mind to focus on the numbers.
I'm listening. Let's keep working through this.
You talk sweet but action is something else.
When was the last time you gave me feedback?
My problem existed since you have joined and you did nothing so far?
